messages:
maria: PR up: rdocs/quickflight#452 — compacted quickstart example, fixed auth link, removed redundant env examples. PTAL
ben: Which link? I still see /docs/quickstart/auth -> 404 locally
maria: Fixed in PR head, the link was absolute to /quickstart/auth-old. Replaced with relative ./auth
xavier: Heads up — runtime team changed default model name; snippet uses model: 'redwood/base' — needs change to 'redwood/latest'. I can send patch
maria: Can you? I'll re-run smoke
xavier: pushed small commit, see diff:
```
- model: 'redwood/base'
+ model: 'redwood/latest'
```
ci-bot: CI: docs-build passed (smoke) — 3 checks
sara: Great. Can we also add a one-liner about minimal Dockerfile? users hit size issues
ben: Suggest: `FROM python:3.11-slim` + `pip install redwood-inference==0.12.1` as minimal example
maria: I'll add a short section and link to runtime guide. Anyone object to removing the long env matrix?
xavier: :thumbsup:
ben: No objections. Linting flagged a trailing comma in codeblock, fixed in PR
maria: Merging after one more review. @xavier can you confirm container smoke in staging later today?
xavier: Yep, will run at 4pm PT
maria: :rocket: thanks all
